name: Todoist
tagline: A personal task app with projects, recurring due dates, filters, and reminders is a one-sitting/weekend build; collaboration and sync polish are the product moat.
verdictSummary: YES: Todoist costs $7/mo ($84/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
